verdict.rationale: Getting a tax ID for a new company is a fair question for an incorporation platform. However, Beglaubigt.de's evidence covers only German entities (GmbH/UG), and its tax-registration feature files an ELSTER questionnaire with the German Finanzamt. That is an adjacent capability, not a US federal EIN, so it earns no credit. Nothing in the evidence shows the platform obtains an EIN.
